description: This file contains a suite of automated tests for various SwiftUI views and system components related to the OpenClaw project. It tests UI components such as context menus, toggle rows, and voice wake cards, as well as system overlays and app behaviors like dock icon visibility and settings helpers.

methods.name: context menu card builds body
methods.description: Tests building the body of the ContextMenuCardView with different states.

methods.name: settings toggle row builds body
methods.description: Tests constructing the SettingsToggleRow view with a toggle binding.

methods.name: voice wake test card builds body across states
methods.description: Tests VoiceWakeTestCard rendering in various states.

methods.name: agent events window builds body with event
methods.description: Tests creation and rendering of the AgentEventsWindow with sample agent event data.

methods.name: notify overlay presents and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presentation and dismissal of the NotifyOverlayController.

methods.name: talk overlay presents twice and dismisses
methods.description: Tests presentation, updating, and dismissal of the TalkOverlayController.

methods.name: visual effect view hosts in NS hosting view
methods.description: Tests embedding VisualEffectView inside an NSHostingView.

methods.name: menu hosted item hosts content
methods.description: Tests embedding a MenuHostedItem in an NSHostingView.

methods.name: dock icon manager updates visibility
methods.description: Tests updating dock icon visibility and temporarily showing the dock.

methods.name: voice wake settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Tests execution of helper functions related to voice wake settings.

methods.name: debug settings exercises helpers
methods.description: Tests asynchronous execution of debug settings helpers.
